exercises.instruction: Answer the questions about the pictures. Use in, at or on with the words below the pictures.

items.prompt: Amy lives in this building. Where’s her flat exactly?

answers: At the top of the stairs.
In the back of the car.

items.prompt: Lisa is in this group of people. Where is she?
Gary is at the cinema. Where is he sitting?

answers: At the end of the street.
